mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mus.FACTORY_CODE, mus.MOULD_CODE, pmr.SPEC_CODE, mmi.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_mould_use_status mus INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mus.MOULD_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mus.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mus.MOULD_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mus.FACTORY_CODE WHERE mus.MOULD_STATUS = 1 AND mus.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mus.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mus.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND pmr.PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT samr.PRODUCT_CODE, samr.FACTORY_CODE, smmi.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation samr INNER JOIN (SELECT mpmr.FACTORY_CODE, mpmr.MOULD_CODE, tmmi.MOULD_NO, mpmr.PRODUCT_CODE FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation mpmr INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info tmmi ON tmmi.FACTORY_CODE = mpmr.FACTORY_CODE AND tmmi.MOULD_CODE = mpmr.MOULD_CODE WHERE mpmr.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mpmr.PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tmmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) smmi ON smmi.FACTORY_CODE = samr.FACTORY_CODE AND smmi.MOULD_CODE = samr.MOULD_CODE WHERE samr.PRODUCT_CODE <> #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT mdmp.FACTORY_CODE, mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AS MOULD_CODE, mdmp.BEGIN_DATE, mdmp.END_DAY, mmi.MOULD_NO, pmr.SPEC_CODE FROM t_mdm_device_maintenance_plan mdmp INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE WHERE IFNULL(mdmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdmp.MACHINE_TYPE = 2 AND mdmp.PLAN_TYPE = 0 AND mdmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdmp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mdmp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND pmr.PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT mus.FACTORY_CODE, mus.MOULD_CODE, mmi.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_mould_use_status mus INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mus.MOULD_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mus.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pmr.FACTORY_CODE, pmr.PRODUCT_CODE, pmr.SPEC_CODE, pmr.MOULD_CODE, sammi.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info sammi ON sammi.FACTORY_CODE = pmr.FACTORY_CODE AND sammi.MOULD_CODE = pmr.MOULD_CODE INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT samr.PRODUCT_CODE, samr.FACTORY_CODE, smmi.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation samr INNER JOIN (SELECT mpmr.FACTORY_CODE, mpmr.MOULD_CODE, tmmi.MOULD_NO, mpmr.PRODUCT_CODE FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation mpmr INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info tmmi ON tmmi.FACTORY_CODE = mpmr.FACTORY_CODE AND tmmi.MOULD_CODE = mpmr.MOULD_CODE WHERE mpmr.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mpmr.PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tmmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) smmi ON smmi.FACTORY_CODE = samr.FACTORY_CODE AND smmi.MOULD_CODE = samr.MOULD_CODE) sarao ON sarao.FACTORY_CODE = pmr.FACTORY_CODE AND sarao.PRODUCT_CODE = pmr.PRODUCT_CODE AND sarao.MOULD_NO = sammi.MOULD_NO) sara ON mus.FACTORY_CODE = sara.FACTORY_CODE AND mus.MOULD_CODE = sara.MOULD_CODE AND mmi.MOULD_NO = sara.MOULD_NO WHERE mus.MOULD_STATUS = 1 AND mus.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mus.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mus.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT mdmp.FACTORY_CODE, mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AS MOULD_CODE, mdmp.BEGIN_DATE, mdmp.END_DAY, mmi.MOULD_NO, pmr.SPEC_CODE FROM t_mdm_device_maintenance_plan mdmp INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE WHERE IFNULL(mdmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdmp.MACHINE_TYPE = 2 AND mdmp.PLAN_TYPE = 0 AND mdmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdmp.BEGIN_DATE >= #{productionStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND mdmp.END_DAY <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND pmr.PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mmi.MOULD_NO = #{mouldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
